summary: the case of tests/run install under etude, against a bootctl that commits a trial that has not booted, a GRUB menu that boots a trial without consuming it, and a kernel whose raw writes of /dev/bootpart land one sector past the one asked

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make components && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh exec ${WORK} sh -c 'exec make -s "$ARCH_BUILD/tests/cases/machine/install.disk" "ARCH=$ARCH" </dev/null' && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} tests/cases/machine/install.disk

faults.name: armed-commit
faults.summary: bootctl commits a candidate whose trial is armed and has not booted

faults.name: unconsumed-trial
faults.summary: the GRUB menu boots the candidate for next_entry=candidate and leaves the variable set, so the trial is never consumed

edits.find:
set default=candidate
    set next_entry=
    save_env next_entry

faults.name: bootpart-shift
faults.summary: a raw write of /dev/bootpart lands one sector past the one asked, so the slot bootctl writes does not read back
